post.summary: Narrow the temporary public administration path to the Operator's own address
post.description: Re-derives the scope of the temporary SSH and Kubernetes API access from a freshly observed Operator address. It cannot reopen a closed path: restoring administrative access to a handed-over cluster is a separate decision. An address that is unobserved, privately routed, or carrier-grade NAT leaves the path open with the reason stated, because a scope that admits nobody — or that moves — would lock the Operator out.

200.description: Cluster detail

409.description: No installed cluster, or the machine identity changed

502.description: The Cluster Node could not be reached

HetznerTokenAssessment.description: Secret-free verdict of validating a Hetzner project token. Identifies the token by fingerprint only.

HetznerResource.description: One inventoried provider resource, identified by its stable provider identity.

HetznerFinding.description: Classification of one expected resource against the inventory. A similarly named resource is reported, never adopted.

HetznerDelegation.description: Nameserver delegation check. Unknown is never treated as confirmed, so a public installation stays blocked.

HetznerCostEstimate.description: Estimated recurring monthly cost from the observed provider catalog, with the notes about resources that remain billable.

HetznerChangePlan.description: Immutable, cost-bearing infrastructure plan bound to the inspection it was derived from. Building it changes nothing in the project.

HetznerToolchain.description: Pinned OpenTofu and provider artifacts with their verification state. Carries no cache paths.

HetznerWorkspace.description: Per-profile isolated OpenTofu state workspace. Reports lock and backup state by digest only, never paths or state contents.

HetznerProject.description: Everything the launcher knows about a profile's Hetzner project. The token value appears nowhere.

OffsiteProtection.description: Secret-free view of an offsite destination and its last bucket inspection. Never carries the access key or secret.

proposal.description: Present once a Change Plan has been submitted: the provider and remote commit identity of the Git proposal. Secret-free.

validation.description: Present once a bounded validation run has settled: the evidence-derived verdict and its remediation route. Drawn from observed offsite evidence, not Job exit status.

OffsiteProposal.description: Result of proposing an approved offsite Change Plan: the Cluster Secret effect and the remote commit identity of the opened Git proposal. Never carries a credential value.

OffsitePlan.description: Change Plan separating the Cluster Secret effect from the non-secret Git diff.

RecoveryBundleExportInput.description: Provide exactly one of passphrase or public age recipients.

RecoveryBundleOpenInput.description: Provide exactly one of passphrase or private age identity.

environmentExtension.description: Placed between each hostname's label and the domain, so a .dev cluster's hostnames can never collide with production's. Empty for production.

release.description: The SmallWorlds release to install. Any release whose published bootstrap asset manifest verifies against the launcher’s compiled release signing key is installable; the launcher does not carry a fixed list.

reference.description: Secret-free Cluster CA metadata (subjects, serials, fingerprints, validity)

TemporaryAccess.description: The temporary public administration path (SSH and the Kubernetes API) that exists between provisioning a cluster and handing it over to private administration.

open.description: False once the path has been closed. Closing requires a verified handoff.

scoped.description: True only when the path is genuinely narrowed.

sources.description: CIDR ranges admitted to SSH and the Kubernetes API. Empty means open to the internet.

reasonKey.description: Why the path is scoped, or why it could not be.

SetupSettings.description: Non-secret answers an operator gave while walking the setup journey. Secrets never appear here; they live in the Launcher Vault.

NodeTrust.description: The machine whose SSH host key this profile has pinned. Recorded, secret-free, and durable, so a returning Operator sees which computer the cluster belongs to without probing it again.

ClusterDetail.description: One read-only picture of the cluster. Unsettled workloads only: a Running pod with every container ready says nothing, and listing it would bury the ones that cannot start.

workloadsTruncated.description: True when more unsettled workloads exist than were reported.

message.description: What the cluster itself says is wrong. Never a credential value.
